text:
olivia: Heads-up — CI link scan flagged a 404 on the docs-prod-checklist page, saw this in Sentry/SEO too. Anyone currently owning that page?

docs-bot: automated-scan — 2026-03-17 09:12 UTC — 1 broken link found -> /runbooks/deploy-checklist -> 404. report id: rb-scan-20260317-09.

sanjay: I used to own that runbook but I handed off runbooks to emily in Q4. not watching that path anymore.

emily: yep, I own the runbooks folder now. thanks for the ping @olivia. is the broken link internal (docs -> docs) or coming from an external site?

olivia: internal link found from docs-prod-checklist -> runbooks. external search engines also crawling it. i'd prefer a redirect so we don't regress SEO.

mike: redirect is simplest. we can add frontmatter redirect_from on the old md and point to new page. i'll volunteer to make the small PR if folks agree.

emily: quick question — should we redirect to /runbooks/deploying-guides or the new consolidated /runbooks/deploy-best-practices page? the latter is more up-to-date.

mike: +1 to deploy-best-practices. smaller surface area to keep maintained.

\emily: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — includes frontmatter redirect and a short note in the changelog. snippet added in PR: 
```yaml
---
title: Deploy Best Practices
redirect_from:
  - /runbooks/deploy-checklist
---
```

sanjay: skimmed the PR — looks good. tiny nit: can you update the top H1 to match the canonical title (Deploy best practices) so redirects don't cause title mismatch? otherwise lgtm.

\emily: good catch, will update in the PR now.

mike: staging preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/4321 — redirect works, no 404s.

olivia: awesome, thanks team. i'll add this to the weekly ops triage to verify prod after merge. :thumbsup:
